nativeCommands: rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p project remote_external_agent
rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p remote_server remote_external_agent

3-implementation.redEvidence: The prior installed app exposed a resolved remote environment in the local SSH argv; generic builders accepted private values, PTY startup had no private readiness channel, and the prior ACP-only plan omitted sibling consumers.
3-implementation.greenEvidence: All 19 rows map to deterministic tests or executable installed UAT. Private netstring framing, POSIX SSH builders, real PTY behavior, terminal ordering, MCP/DAP ordering, the full consumer inventory, capability mismatch, unsupported backends, content-free receipts, package identity, exhaustive route coverage, and installed picker launch classes now have named executable coverage. The full remote_server target set found and closed a stale capability assertion plus an under-budgeted cold-start harness timeout.

4-execution.summary: All 19 rows have direct, executed evidence. ACP-JOURNEY-002 binds every independently selectable route in the exact 12-entry Mac and 16-entry Intrepid healthy inventories. ACP-ASSEMBLED-019 separately binds the installed picker and session/new boundary for all five production execution classes. External authentication or permission refusal remains an explicit route classification rather than a product-origin failure, and cleanup is green.

5-analysis.summary: The exact tested revision and load-bearing picker inventory are bound. Every advertised Mac-local and Intrepid entry has route-level evidence, every production launch class has installed-app picker/session evidence, and the stronger project-read oracle rejects prompt echo and unrelated split calls.

6-tracking.reason: No unresolved product or test-plan defect remains to track from this lifecycle; public notarization and external provider-account readiness remain explicitly out of scope.

Corrected the live TCP canary to send Python source across SSH as one shell-quoted remote command and added a RED argv-shape regression.
Corrected the ACP canary to bind one exact sentinel path to observed file bytes, or an exact project-confined client read, and added prompt-echo plus unrelated split-evidence negatives.
Kept the terminal UAT fixture alive across SIGWINCH until the intended Ctrl-C.
Sanitized captured PROMPT_COMMAND while preserving explicit terminal and task overrides.
Anchored remote Vim shell commands to the first opened project directory.
Classified real header/body disconnect I/O and replayed initialize once only for SSH/TCP within the existing timeout.
Returned a protocol-valid empty DAP threads list from the fake adapter.
